notes: Design freeze for the 2x2 continual-learning x authority-governance factorial. Status is DRAFT, not PROTOCOL_FROZEN: the design decisions below are settled, but the execution coordinates carry PENDING_FREEZE sentinels because the real hashes do not exist yet and inventing them would fabricate a freeze that never happened. Promotion to PROTOCOL_FROZEN requires every PENDING_FREEZE sentinel to be replaced by a real identity and requires upstream blockers #238 and #242 to be stabilized first.

U-R.state_rule: every development or transfer task starts at exactly S0; the registered state remains S0 afterwards

U-L.state_rule: U-S0 -> U-S1 -> ... -> U-Sn over the shared development order; every transfer task starts independently from the frozen U-Sn

G-R.state_rule: every development or transfer task starts at exactly S0; the registered state remains S0 afterwards

G-L.state_rule: G-S0 -> G-S1 -> ... -> G-Sn over the same development order; every transfer task starts independently from the frozen G-Sn. U-Sn and G-Sn need not be byte-identical; the divergence is the intervention and is recorded

removed_authority_checks: PENDING_FREEZE: enumerate each removed RAKL typed authority check by identity before execution; a bare 'governance disabled' entry is not admissible
matched_coordinates: base model, revision and sampling parameters
evidence and context presented to the proposer
memory object count, token budget and retrieval-call allowance

G1_verified_corrective_knowledge.rule: each frozen post-development state must contain at least one verified corrective object derived from an observed correct resolution or an evidence-bearing correction; job 3476548 had development success_rate 0.0 on both arms and minted only a generic pseudo-lesson, so its learning state held nothing correct to transfer

G2_selective_retrieval_ran.rule: for any arm specified to retrieve, retrieval_calls > 0 is blocking at task level; job 3476548 recorded total_retrieval_calls 0.0 on all four arm/phase rows while the learning arm used 4376 input tokens against the reset arm's 1502, the signature of whole-state prompt stuffing rather than retrieval

G3_state_chronology_intact.rule: no cross-task state leakage; every transfer task starts from the same frozen state hash for its cell; T1 must never teach T2

G4_resource_ceiling_respected.rule: one ceiling shared by all four cells; actual usage reported per cell, never only the ceiling

G5_no_post_outcome_evaluator_mutation.rule: evaluator, parser and threshold identities are fixed before outcome access; mutation after outcomes forfeits confirmatory status

REPEATED_FAMILY.purpose: same deep task family under materially changed surface form

CROSS_DOMAIN_TRANSFER.purpose: prior experience is useful only if scope and structure genuinely match

HOSTILE_NEAR_MISS.purpose: prior experience is tempting but invalid under a changed boundary, QoI or context; measures over-transfer

AUTHORITY_TRANSITION.purpose: cases from #154 where the correct scientific-state update is known; measures transition validity

estimands.E_ungated: U-L minus U-R: experience effect when scientific-authority governance is absent
estimands.E_gated: G-L minus G-R: experience effect under RAKL governance
estimands.G_reset: G-R minus U-R: governance effect without cumulative experience
estimands.G_learning: G-L minus U-L: governance effect on experience-amplified overreach

analysis.multiplicity_control: Holm family-wise error control over the frozen confirmatory family unless a stricter hierarchical gate is frozen before execution

admissible_outcomes: gates suppress legitimate updates too aggressively
RAKL costs too much for the observed benefit
one or more cells report CANNOT_IDENTIFY under the admissibility gates
